name: Weak day (long) set, then a 38% retracement that turns
why: After a weak close dip buyers absorb the forced selling and the session bounces (weak-day long, no VIX). Buy (sell) a 38.2% give-back of the move from the open once it turns. Pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_direction_sources.md).
